verdict.why_en: The framework landed on Underweight: the measurable deterioration in Tesla's core auto business — a P/E of 304, negative free cash flow, and shrinking market share — outweighs speculative AI narratives with no revenue timeline.
verdict.why_zh: 该框架给出减持评级：核心汽车业务可衡量的恶化——市盈率304倍、自由现金流为负、市场份额萎缩——压过了缺乏收入时间表的投机性AI叙事。

stances.en: P/E of 304 with margins halved and FCF turning negative.
stances.zh: 市盈率304倍，利润率腰斩，自由现金流转负。

stances.en: Mildly bullish score of 6 out of 10, nothing decisive.
stances.zh: 情绪得分6/10，温和看多但不够明确。

stances.en: Terafab breaks ground, but UK sales drop and Rivian looms.
stances.zh: Terafab动工，但英国销量下滑，Rivian步步紧逼。

stances.en: Below both SMAs, RSI neutral — no entry signal yet.
stances.zh: 股价低于两条均线，RSI中性，无入场信号。

split.bear_en: P/E of 304 with margins halved and FCF turning negative.
split.bear_zh: 市盈率304倍，利润率腰斩，自由现金流转负。
split.pivot_en: The bull sees Terafab and Optimus as Tesla transforming into an AI-robotics giant. The bear counters those are unproven science projects while the core auto business is deteriorating — negative FCF, halved margins, and market share lost to Chinese rivals.
split.pivot_zh: 多方认为Terafab和Optimus让特斯拉转型为AI机器人巨头。空方反驳称这些是未经验证的科学项目，而核心汽车业务正在恶化——自由现金流为负、利润率腰斩、市场份额被中国对手蚕食。
